title: Health Data Bridge
summary: Map Health Connect activity and weight records to a private local log.
user: An Android fitness or nutrition logger who needs a visible, local import map from Health Connect data to a personal log.
smallest_useful_product: Android app that asks for narrow Health Connect read permissions, previews each record type and date range, maps activity and weight records to a local CSV or JSON log, and records idempotent import receipts.
success_measure: A pilot user imports one month of activity and weight in under five minutes, with zero duplicate records after a second import.
constraints: Use Android Health Connect permissions only; minimum necessary scopes; no medical claims; encrypt local files; publish a plain-language data-flow screen.
